entities.summary: Protected areas of Slovenia include one national park, three regional parks, several natural parks, and hundreds of natural monuments and monuments of designed nature. They cover about 12.5% of the Slovenian territory. Under the Wild Birds Directive, 26 sites totalling roughly 25% of the nation's land are "Special Protected Areas"; the Natura 2000 proposal would increase the totals to 260 sites and 32% of national territory.
